headline: EFCC Probes Ex-Banker Over Alleged N515 Million Diversion
summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission is investigating a former bank operations manager for the alleged diversion of N515 million from a Bank of Industry loan repayment account.
why: Financial crime investigations highlight compliance risks and governance oversight within commercial banking operations.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Regulatory investigations underscore internal control and risk management challenges.
